parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of multiple FilteredRelation with the same relation being ignored by ensuring that the alias is reused only if the filtered_relation is None.

issues.description: The patch may introduce a behavioral regression risk by changing the alias reuse logic, which could affect other parts of the code that rely on the current behavior.
The patch introduces a non-minimal change by modifying the alias reuse logic, which could make the code less readable and maintainable.
